responsibility: This header declares the Fortran front end’s matcher API and parser-facing matching state. It exposes prototypes for low-level token matchers, statement-specific matchers, OpenMP/OpenACC directive matchers, declaration/attribute matchers, expression and array matchers, and module/interface/IO matchers, along with shared globals such as current statement label and flags for pointer-assignment or prefix matching.
same_name_distinction: Declares the parser-facing matcher API and shared matching globals used throughout the front end. Unlike gcc/fortran/match.cc, it is the interface contract for matching functions, not the code that parses the constructs.
